svg.aria-label: Argus: a health check fails, an outage opens, Telegram is notified, recovery is measured
svg.title: Argus: a health check fails, an outage opens, Telegram is notified, recovery is measured

g.text: A GET hits the health URL every 60 s. Every result is stored.
The check times out, so Argus opens an outage.
An alert is raised. The alerter pushes it to Telegram and marks it sent.
It comes back. The downtime is measured, not guessed.
